visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair is filmed in a retail store, standing in front of a shelf packed with facial mask products. She is wearing a white top with a pink lanyard and has a cheerful facial expression. Behind her, rows of colorful packets with cartoon character faces (pink, blue, yellow) are densely packed on hanging racks. (2) She points toward the 'Chiikawa' character masks and then selects a specific pink packet, holding it up close to the camera lens. The store lighting is bright and white, reflecting off the plastic packaging. (3) The scene cuts to a closer shot in an indoor bedroom or hotel room. The same woman is now wearing the printed facial mask on her face, which has pink cheeks and black eye markings like a cartoon character. She wears pink pajamas and holds the empty pink packet next to her face to compare. The background lighting is warmer and softer than the store.
